The Becket Arts Center is committed to contributing to the creative lives of the residents of Becket and beyond through affordable, accessible programming. Our community is diverse across economic status, age, ability and disability, and we strive to create inclusive arts experiences that are welcoming and meaningful for all

services.name: Sashiko Mending Workshop
services.desc: This workshop will highlight the act of mending and garment embellishment with Sashiko Japanese Embroidery. With humble beginnings in rural Japan, Sashiko’s running stitch insulated work garments for warmth and longevity. Moving into contemporary times around the globe, the bold, geometric beauty of Sashiko continues to both strengthen and decorate fabrics. Sashiko’s Geometric Patterns and Motifs are inspired by nature, architecture, and culture. Students will learn how to patch and repair a rip or hole, reinforce a worn area, and prepare their distressed textile in order to draw a Sashiko pattern of their choice.
